language.name: English
notify.title: New mail in Inbox
settings.title: Settings
settings.decorationHint: Draw the title bar in the app. Wayland only; on KDE add a “No titlebar and frame” window rule first.
settings.perfHint: Shows CPU, memory, goroutine count and frame rate in the top bar.
settings.proxyHint: http, https or socks5, optionally with user:password; empty for a direct connection.
settings.proxyInvalid: Enter a full proxy address, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080.
settings.proxyUnset: No proxy is configured. Add one in Settings → General → Proxy before using this option.
settings.accountTypeGmailHint: Sign in with a Google account and use the Gmail API
settings.accountTypeSMTPHint: Send from another address while reading any mailbox
settings.accountIntro: Create an OAuth client of type “Desktop app” in Google Cloud Console and enable the Gmail API, then paste its client ID and secret here. The app receives the callback on 127.0.0.1, so no redirect URI has to be registered.
settings.accountAuthHint: Open this link in a browser and approve access. The app waits for the answer on 127.0.0.1, so the browser has to run on this machine.
settings.accountEmailMismatch: That Google account is {{.Email}}, not {{.Account}}. Sign in with the account you want to refresh.
settings.sendAccountsHint: SMTP servers the composer can send through. Nothing is read from them, and the messages they send do not appear in the Gmail sent folder.
settings.smtpIntro: The server only sends. A draft written in any mailbox can go out as this address, so the message exists in the Gmail sent folder only if you have it blind-copied back.
settings.smtpPlainWarning: No encryption: the password travels in the clear. Use it only for a relay on your own network.
settings.smtpUsernameHint: Leave empty for a server that needs no login
settings.smtpPasswordHint: Stored in the accounts file, never logged
settings.smtpSenderNameHint: Optional, shown next to the address
settings.smtpBccTitle: Blind-copy the Gmail account by default
settings.smtpBccHint: Picking this sender fills the Bcc field with the address of the mailbox you write in. You can clear or change it per message.
settings.smtpAddressInvalid: Enter one sender address, for example name@example.com.
settings.smtpSaveFailed: Could not save the sending account.
shortcut.hint: Shortcuts work while no text field has focus; Ctrl+W and Ctrl+Q work anywhere. While a panel is open, only Esc, Ctrl+W and Ctrl+Q act.
sidebar.labelsUnavailable: Label management is not available yet.
list.emptyHint: Try another folder, or adjust your search.
reader.emptyTitle: Select a conversation to start reading
reader.emptyHint: Pick a conversation from the list and the whole thread appears here.
reader.noPlainText: This message has no plain-text part.
source.title: Original message
source.subject: Subject
compose.subject: Subject
compose.attachUnavailable: The desktop file picker is not available.
attachment.name: attachment
error.unsupported: This account does not support that action.
error.invalidArgument: The request was rejected. Check the recipients and try again.
error.unauthorized: This account has to be authorized again.
error.authTimeout: The browser did not finish the authorization in time.
error.smtpAuth: The sending server rejected the login. Check the username and password.
toast.starFailed: Could not update the star. The change was reverted.
toast.openFailed: Could not open the HTML version: {{.Error}}
toast.smtpRemoveFailed: Could not delete the sending account
